v. 大声讲或读( dictate的第三人称单数 ); 口授; 支配; 摆布

dictating.definition:
v issue commands or orders for
v say out loud for the purpose of recording
v rule as a dictator

dictation.definition:
n. speech intended for reproduction in writing
n. matter that has been dictated and transcribed; a dictated passage
dictation.translation: n. 听写, 口述, 命令

dictations.definition:
n. an authoritative direction or instruction to do something
n. speech intended for reproduction in writing
n. matter that has been dictated and transcribed; a dictated passage
dictations.translation: n. 口授, 听写( dictation的复数形式 ); 听写测验

dictator.definition:
n. a speaker who dictates to a secretary or a recording machine
n. a ruler who is unconstrained by law
dictator.translation: n. 命令者, 独裁者

dictatorial.definition: a. of or characteristic of a dictator
dictatorial.translation: a. 独裁者的, 独裁的, 独断的

dictatorially.definition: r in an overbearingly domineering manner; as a dictator
dictatorially.translation: adv. 独裁地, 自大地

dictators.definition:
n. a speaker who dictates to a secretary or a recording machine
n. a ruler who is unconstrained by law
n. a person who behaves in a tyrannical manner
dictators.translation: n. 独裁者( dictator的复数形式 ); 专制者; 发号施令者; 专横的人

dictatorship.definition: n. a form of government in which the ruler is an absolute dictator (not restricted by a constitution or laws or opposition etc.)
dictatorship.translation:
n. 独裁者之职位, 独裁, 独裁政权
[法] 专攻, 独裁权

dictatorships.definition: n. a form of government in which the ruler is an absolute dictator (not restricted by a constitution or laws or opposition etc.)
dictatorships.translation: n. 独裁, 专政( dictatorship的复数形式 ); 独裁统治的国家

dictatress.definition: n. A woman who dictates or commands.
dictatress.translation: n. 女独裁者, 女非正式授者, 女非正式述者, 女专政者

dictature.definition: n. Office of a dictator; dictatorship.

diction.definition:
n the articulation of speech regarded from the point of view of its intelligibility to the audience
n the manner in which something is expressed in words
diction.translation: n. 措辞, 发音, 用语

dictionaries.translation: n. 词典, 字典( dictionary的名词复数 )

dictionary.definition: n. a reference book containing an alphabetical list of words with information about them
dictionary.translation:
n. 字典, 词典
[计] 词典

dictum.definition:
n an authoritative declaration
n an opinion voiced by a judge on a point of law not directly bearing on the case in question and therefore not binding
dictum.translation:
n. 声明, 格言, 法官意见
[法] 宣言, 声明, 法官的意见

dictums.translation: n. 宣言( dictum的名词复数 ); 声明; 名言; 格言

dicty.translation:
a. 高级的, 傲慢的, 有钱的, 时髦的, 漂亮的
n. 贵族, 时髦人, 富人

dictyogen.definition:
n. A plant with net-veined leaves, and monocotyledonous
   embryos, belonging to the class Dictyogenae, proposed by Lindley for
   the orders Dioscoreaceae, Smilaceae, Trilliaceae, etc.

dictyokinesis.translation: (分散)高尔基体分裂, 网体分裂

dictyoprolene.translation: 十一碳二烯醇 乙酸酯

dictyopsia.translation: [医] 网视症(眼前似有网张开的感觉)

dictyosome.definition: n a netlike structure in the cytoplasm of animal cells (especially in those cells that produce secretions)

dicudonne's medium.translation: [医] 迪厄多内氏培养基, 迪厄多内氏硷性血[液]琼脂

dicumarol.definition: n an anticoagulant drug that has now been largely replaced by warfarin

dicumyl peroxide.translation: [化] 过氧化二枯基; 过氧化双苯异丙基

dicyandiamidine.translation: (=guanylurea)脒基脲, 胍基甲 酰 胺

dicyanide.definition:
n. A compound of a binary type containing two cyanogen
   groups or radicals; -- called also bicyanide.

dicyclohexyl amine.translation: [化] 二环己胺; 二环己基胺

dicyclohexyl phthalat.translation: [化] 邻苯二甲酸二环己酯

dicyclohexyl-18-crown-6(dc18c6).translation: [化] 二环己基并-18-冠-6; 二环己基并-18-冠醚-6

dicyclohexylurea(dcu).translation: [化] 二环己脲; 二环己基脲

dicyclomine.translation:
[化] 双环维林; 双环胺
[医] 双环胺

dicycloverine.translation: [化] 双环维林; 双环胺

dicynodontia.translation: [网络] 二齿兽下目；二齿兽亚目；二犬齿兽亚目

dicynodonts.definition:
plural of dicynodont
n a kind of therapsid
dicynodonts.translation: (dicynodont 的复数) n.[古生]二齿兽
